name: PivoRonpa 2: The Ultimate Beer
source:
In this installment, we will finally discover how Hinata and Nagito met, what kind of relationship Naegi and Kirigiri have, and exactly what is happening at home with Owari and Nidai. We will also get a deeper look into Nidai and Naegi, who will have specific parts of the narrative dedicated to them. Plus, for the very first time, we will get to experience Shaha as a fully realized character with their own feelings and emotions.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1298919693]Steam[/url]]
